title: MOKS · Investigations and CrewAI
description: Investigations by engine, the CrewAI flows (incident flow steps, agents, graded conclusions, validation) and the unified pipeline's stages. Labels are names and statuses, never targets or model text.

links.title: jithendar.com
links.tooltip: Articles about how this is built

panels.title: Investigations
panels.description: Investigations that finished in the time range, every engine and outcome.

panels.title: Completed
panels.description: Share of investigations in the time range that completed.

panels.title: Crew runs
panels.description: CrewAI console flows asked to run in the time range (workload, incident and unified investigations).

panels.title: Crews fell back or unavailable
panels.description: Crew runs that LangGraph answered instead, or that could not start (CrewAI off, flow switched off, no slot, outside scope).

panels.title: Crews running
panels.description: Crews holding a slot now, across workers (crewai_max_concurrent per worker).

panels.title: Investigation p95
panels.description: 95th percentile investigation wall time in the time range, every engine.

panels.title: Investigations by engine and outcome
panels.description: Finished investigations per bar. crewai_fallback: the crew's answer did not survive validation and LangGraph's report writer ran over its evidence.

panels.title: Investigation duration
panels.description: Wall time by engine. Points only where investigations finished in that window.

panels.title: Event streams
panels.description: Browser event streams that follow investigations: open now, and how closed ones ended per bar.

panels.title: Crew runs by flow and outcome
panels.description: Per bar. completed and partial are the crew's own status; fallback means LangGraph wrote the report; unavailable means the flow never started.

panels.title: Crew errors and early stops
panels.description: Per bar, by code: budget_exhausted, task_timeout, iteration_limit, invalid_output, provider_error, run_timeout, fallback. A run can have several.

panels.title: Crew slots in use
panels.description: Crews holding a slot, next to all running investigations. A crew that waits too long for a slot falls back or reports unavailable.

panels.title: Step p95 duration
panels.description: 95th percentile wall time of each step in the time range (plan, kubernetes, observability, change, knowledge, hypotheses, review, rca).

panels.title: Steps by outcome
panels.description: Step attempts in the time range. partial: a limit ended the step with what it had; invalid_output: the answer never matched the step's contract.

panels.title: Tokens by agent
panels.description: Model tokens (input and output) each agent used in the time range. The token budget is per investigation (CrewAI console limits).

panels.title: Tokens by agent over time
panels.description: Tokens per bar, by agent.

panels.title: Step outcomes over time
panels.description: Step attempts per bar by outcome.

panels.title: Conclusions as MOKS graded them
panels.description: Findings and hypotheses of incident runs in the time range, by the status MOKS's grading gave them (never the model's own word).

panels.title: Validation changes
panels.description: Per bar: citations rejected (ids no evidence has), claims removed, and hypotheses whose confidence MOKS lowered.

panels.title: Reviewer evidence requests
panels.description: Evidence the reviewer asked for, per bar: collected, already_collected, refused (no specialist has the tool, or policy said no) or not_run.

panels.title: Stage outcomes
panels.description: Unified-pipeline stages that did not complete in the time range: partial (time or tool budget), failed, skipped or cancelled.

panels.title: Stage p95 duration
panels.description: 95th percentile wall time of each of the fifteen stages in the time range. Skipped stages are not timed.

panels.title: Stages over time
panels.description: Stage ends per bar, by status.

panels.title: Tool calls by outcome
panels.description: Read-only tool calls from every engine. forbidden and denied are policy; timeout and unavailable are the dependency.

panels.title: Most used tools
panels.description: Tool calls in the time range.

panels.title: Tools that fail
panels.description: Share of each tool's calls in the time range that did not succeed (invalid arguments excluded). MoksToolCallsFailing fires above 50%.

panels.title: Investigation and crew events
panels.description: Lines are logfmt after Alloy; a trace_id opens the trace in Jaeger. Full lines (with redacted errors) are in kubectl logs.
